skill_name: Create a recipe for a plant-based dish that would be suitable for a large vegan dinner party.
workflow: A great recipe for a vegan dinner party would be a Rainbow Buddha Bowl. This recipe requires cooked quinoa, roasted vegetables, cubed tofu, and a homemade dressing. To prepare the roasted vegetables, combine bell peppers, zucchini, onion, and cauliflower with a drizzle of olive oil, garlic powder, and pepper in a large bowl, then spread it on a baking sheet.
